name: Oohara Maya
source:
A mutual friend of Akane and Miyako. Has two younger brothers.

Likes to stir up trouble by telling Akane and Miyako unnecessary things. The culprit behind this incident.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/axh/axh_chr.html#maya]official site[/url]]
